rule: Korean amount units are 100 million USD (억 달러); candidate amount must be finite positive <=500 units and signed YoY magnitude <=300 percentage points.

Collect every exact amount/YoY pair from Korean table candidates, current-month timeline candidates with semiconductor context, and within 90 characters of Korean narrative proximity windows; do not select by future returns.

English cross-check requires Korean amount/10 within 0.05 USD billion of an English $X billion token and abs(Korean YoY) within 0.05 percentage point of an English percent token in the same semiconductor/chip context window.

A Korean pair is source-supported if it has an English cross-check plus one Korean method, or agrees across at least two different Korean methods. If multiple distinct pairs are supported for a version, version is unresolved.

All versions of a dual-version month must have one identical supported pair; otherwise month unresolved. Negative YoY sign not independently established by an English decrease/down phrase is flagged for manual source-only review.
This is current-file semantic consistency only; historical first-public vintage remains unqualified.
stop: No numeric Qlib feature or market outcome unless all 93 months and versions pass a later explicit source qualification review.
